ck_ingredient_link.name: ck_ingredient_link
ck_ingredient_link.value: "recipe_ingredient"."food_id" IS NOT NULL OR "recipe_ingredient"."frozen_kcal_100" IS NOT NULL

ck_weight_goal_terms.name: ck_weight_goal_terms
ck_weight_goal_terms.value:
("weight_goal"."mode" = 'target_date' AND "weight_goal"."target_date" IS NOT NULL AND "weight_goal"."rate_kg_per_week" IS NULL)
       OR ("weight_goal"."mode" = 'rate' AND "weight_goal"."rate_kg_per_week" IS NOT NULL AND "weight_goal"."target_date" IS NULL)

ck_line_reps.name: ck_line_reps
ck_line_reps.value: "routine_line"."reps_min" IS NULL OR "routine_line"."reps_max" IS NULL OR "routine_line"."reps_min" <= "routine_line"."reps_max"

ck_set_target_reps.name: ck_set_target_reps
ck_set_target_reps.value: "session_set"."target_reps_min" IS NULL OR "session_set"."target_reps_max" IS NULL OR "session_set"."target_reps_min" <= "session_set"."target_reps_max"
